description: M15 reaction registry — 30+ launch reactions for the active material kernel. Per Noita-grade systemic materials direction. Each reaction takes 1-2 reactant material ids + optional environmental trigger (temperature / electric / pressure) and produces 1-2 product material ids + visual / audio effects. Feeds M15 cellular automaton step. Material ids match material_registry_full.json v2.
